Call peaks per group of cells

rs_atac_call_peaks.Rd

A port of MACS3 callpeak without control.

Usage

rs_atac_call_peaks(
  fragments,
  barcodes,
  groups,
  tag_source,
  keep_dup,
  shift,
  extsize,
  genome_size,
  llocal,
  q_value,
  min_length,
  max_gap,
  max_mem_gb,
  tmp_dir
)

Arguments

fragments

String. The fragment file.

barcodes

Character vector. Cells.

groups

Integer vector. Group of each cell, 0..n_groups.

tag_source

String. "insertion" or "fragment_start".

keep_dup

Optional integer. Tags kept per position, NULL for all.

shift

Integer. Tag shift before extension.

extsize

Integer. Tag extension.

genome_size

Numeric. Effective genome size.

llocal

Integer. Local lambda window.

q_value

Numeric. q-value cutoff.

min_length

Optional integer. Minimum peak length, NULL for extsize.

max_gap

Optional integer. Largest merged gap, NULL for MACS's tag size.

max_mem_gb

Optional numeric. Tag budget of the first pass, NULL for one chromosome at a time.

tmp_dir

Optional string. Directory of the tag scratch file, NULL for the system one.

Value

A list with group (0-based), chrom, start, end, summit (0-based), pileup, pscore, fold and qscore. Groups in order, peaks by chromosome name and position.
